statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field is directly mapped from the 'Depreciation and amortization' line item in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income...' section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows. No other elements from the statement or supplementary tables were combined, as this is a single, explicit line item. The supplementary tables provide details on operating lease assets and liabilities but do not provide a separate depreciation/amortization figure that should be added to the primary statement value.
